_note: The Freedom Wall after each day's report (scripts/rules/freedom_wall.gd). Each post's "when" says when it may show up: line_lost, great_day (3 stars), rough_day (1 star or less), walked_out, favor or favor:<favors.json id>, wrong_office (sent to the wrong open office), closed_office:<office>, false_alarms, turned_away or turned_away:<reject_reasons.json id>, found_section, day_N, <regular id>_good or _bad (that regular came today; bad if any call on them went wrong), or any (filler). An optional "days" list limits a post to those days, for posts about one visit or a check that starts on a later day. One post per thing that happened, 3 to 6 a day. author is anon or a regular's events.json id. likes is a [min, max] range. screen holds the page's own text; reactions can use {likes}, subtitle {day}.

screen.title: FREEDOM WALL
screen.subtitle: Day {day} · what Carolinians posted about Window 3 today

posts.author: anon
posts.ceb: Mas dugay pa ko naghuwat sa loading sa ISMIS kaysa sa biyahe sa 13C gikan Colon paingon Talamban hehe.
posts.en: I waited longer for ISMIS to load than the 13C jeepney ride from Colon to Talamban hehe.

posts.author: anon
posts.ceb: Kinsay nakakita og green nga ballpen sa Registrar? Mao to akong swerte nga ballpen sa enrollment, palihug iuli :(
posts.en: Who found a green pen at the Registrar? That was my lucky enrollment pen, please return it :(

posts.author: anon
posts.ceb: Shoutout sa akong pitaka nga igo ra gyud naka-survive sa assessment slip ug duha ka tuhog nga siomai sa canteen.
posts.en: Shoutout to my wallet for barely surviving the assessment slip and two sticks of canteen siomai.

posts.author: anon
posts.ceb: Nganong inig abot nako sa atubangan sa window, kalit man ko makalimot sa akong kaugalingong ID number?!
posts.en: Why do I suddenly forget my own ID number the second I reach the front of the window?!

posts.author: anon
posts.ceb: Init kaayo sa gawas, pero sa sulod sa Registrar, ang kakulba sa akong grades ang makapasingot nako.
posts.en: It's blazing hot outside, but inside the Registrar my grade anxiety is what makes me sweat.

posts.author: anon
posts.ceb: Pro tip: pagdala og paypay, tubig, ug taas nga pasensya. Murag side quest gyud ning enrollment kada sem.
posts.en: Pro tip: bring a fan, water, and lots of patience. Enrollment really feels like a side quest every sem.

posts.author: anon
posts.ceb: Kanang tingog sa stamp sa Window 3 ba, murag musika sa akong dunggan basta APPROVED ang tatak :D
posts.en: That stamp sound at Window 3 is like music to my ears as long as it says APPROVED :D

posts.author: anon
posts.ceb: Window 3 karon, paspas kaayo! Wala pa ko kahuman sa akong kape, human na ko.
posts.en: Window 3 today, so fast! I hadn't even finished my coffee and I was done.

posts.author: anon
posts.ceb: Kinsa tong SA sa Window 3 ganina? Grabe ka-sharp, usa ka tan-aw ra sa akong papeles human dayon!
posts.en: Who was the SA at Window 3 earlier? Super sharp, one look at my papers and it was done right away!

posts.author: anon
posts.ceb: Abi nakog maabtan kog udto sa linya, pero murag turbo man ang Window 3 karon. Bigyan ng jacket ang SA!
posts.en: I thought I'd be stuck in line till noon, but Window 3 was on turbo today. Give that SA a jacket!

posts.author: anon
posts.ceb: Hapsay kaayo ang Window 3 karon, walay saba ug paspas ang dagan sa pila. Sana all ing-ani kada enrollment :D
posts.en: Window 3 was so smooth today, zero drama and the line moved fast. Wish every enrollment day was like this :D

posts.author: anon
posts.ceb: Murag wala pa nakakape ang SA sa Window 3 karon... kaduha na nibalik akong sinundan sa linya huhu.
posts.en: Looks like the SA at Window 3 hasn't had coffee yet... the person ahead of me came back twice already huhu.

posts.author: anon
posts.ceb: Unsay nahitabo sa Window 3 ganina? Nagkaguliyang man ang mga papel, murag na-mental block apil ang counter :(
posts.en: What happened at Window 3 earlier? Papers were all over the place, even the counter had a mental block :(

posts.author: anon
posts.ceb: Ginhawa lang, SA sa Window 3! Kita tanan gi-atake sa enrollment stress karon, kaya ra lagi na.
posts.en: Just breathe, Window 3 SA! Enrollment stress is hitting all of us today, you'll get through it.

posts.author: anon
posts.ceb: Kadaghan ba sa nagbagulbol gikan sa Window 3 karon uy. Pag-double check intawon sa ISMIS sa dili pa mo-stamp!
posts.en: So many people grumbling on their way back from Window 3 today. Please double-check ISMIS before stamping!

posts.author: anon
posts.ceb: Hala, nigawas na gyud si Ma'am Lorna sa Window 3! Sa sobra ka-dugay sa linya, siya na ang nipuli sa counter.
posts.en: Whoa, Ma'am Lorna actually came out to Window 3! The line took so long she took over the counter herself.

posts.author: anon
posts.ceb: Nahurot gyud ang pasensya sa pila sa Window 3 ganina. Pag-ingon ni Ma'am Lorna og 'Ako na ani,' hilom tanan uy!
posts.en: The Window 3 line completely ran out of patience earlier. When Ma'am Lorna said 'I'll take it from here,' everyone went dead silent!

posts.author: anon
posts.ceb: Pahuway sa, SA sa Window 3! Si Ma'am Lorna na ang nipuli nimo ganina, pero makabawi ra ka :)
posts.en: Take a breather, Window 3 SA! Ma'am Lorna took over for you earlier, but you'll bounce back :)

posts.author: anon
posts.ceb: Kaduha ko gipabalik-balik sa Window 3 nga walay klarong rason! Niuli na lang ko uy, bahala na to :(
posts.en: Window 3 sent me back and forth twice for no good reason! I just went home, forget it :(

posts.author: anon
posts.ceb: Kita gyud ko nga ni-walk out tong usa ka estudyante sa Window 3 human masaypan og kaduha. Sakit tan-awon uy.
posts.en: I watched a student straight-up walk out of Window 3 after getting mishandled twice. Painful to watch.

posts.author: anon
posts.ceb: Kapoya anang pabalikon ka unya sayop diay ang gitatak! Naa gyuy nilakaw sa kalagot ganina sa Window 3.
posts.en: Nothing's more exhausting than being sent away on a wrong stamp! Someone walked out in frustration at Window 3 earlier.

posts.author: anon
posts.ceb: Hmm, kita ko atong gihatagan og merienda sa Window 3 ha... kalit man lang na-APPROVED bisan walay check-check?
posts.en: Hmm, I saw that merienda handoff at Window 3... how did they get APPROVED instantly without any checks?

posts.author: anon
posts.ceb: Naa diay express lane sa Window 3 basta moingon ka nga pag-umangkon ka ni Dean? Bantay lang mo kang Ma'am Lorna!
posts.en: So there's an express lane at Window 3 if you claim to be the Dean's nephew? Watch out for Ma'am Lorna!

posts.author: anon
posts.ceb: Naghuwat mi og tarong sa linya unya naay gipalusot sa Window 3. Nagtan-aw ra ba ang tibuok pila :(
posts.en: We're waiting fairly in line and someone just got waved through at Window 3. The whole queue saw that :(

posts.author: anon
posts.ceb: Gi-flag sa Window 3 akong ID kay 'Ma.' ang nakasulat imbes nga 'Maria'! Normal ra man intawon na nga short form uy.
posts.en: Window 3 flagged my ID because it said 'Ma.' instead of 'Maria'! That's a completely normal abbreviation.

posts.author: anon
posts.ceb: Kulbaa sa SA sa Window 3 karon, tanan na lang gi-flag bisan sakto ra ang akong papeles ug ISMIS record hehe.
posts.en: The SA at Window 3 is so jumpy today, flagging everything even when my papers and ISMIS record match hehe.

posts.author: anon
posts.ceb: Gipaadto ko sa Consultation sa Window 3 unya nag-coffee break pa diay ang mga adviser! Sayang akong lakaw uy.
posts.en: Window 3 sent me to Consultation while the advisers were on coffee break! What a wasted trip.

posts.author: anon
posts.ceb: Naka-exercise kog ahat ganina! Gipadala ko sa Window 3 sa opisina nga wala diay koy labot didto :(
posts.en: Got an unplanned workout earlier! Window 3 routed me to an office that had nothing to do with my form :(

posts.author: anon
posts.ceb: Sirado na ang Dean's Office pag-abot nako didto! Tan-awa intawon ang office schedule sa dili pa mo mag-route uy.
posts.en: The Dean's Office was already closed when I got there! Please check the office schedule before routing us.

posts.author: anon
posts.ceb: Gi-reject ko sa Window 3 kay kulang akong library clearance. Sakit, pero sige na lang, nakalimot man gyud ko hehe.
posts.en: Got turned away at Window 3 for a missing library clearance. Hurts, but fair enough, I really did forget it hehe.

posts.author: anon
posts.ceb: Walay lusot sa Window 3 uy! Nasakpan akong 5.0 sa prereq sa Grades tab. Balik na lang ko sa sugod ani :(
posts.en: Nothing gets past Window 3! They caught my 5.0 prerequisite on the Grades tab. Back to square one for me :(

posts.author: anon
posts.ceb: Strikto kaayo ang Window 3 sa pirma sa adviser, gi-kompara gyud sa specimen sheet! Sakto ra pud hinuon.
posts.en: Window 3 is super strict with adviser signatures, checked it right against the specimen sheet! Fair play though.

posts.author: anon
posts.ceb: Puno na unta akong block section, maayo gani nakakita pa ang SA sa Window 3 og schedule nga walay conflict! Lifesaver :D
posts.en: My block section was full, good thing the Window 3 SA found an open schedule with zero conflict! Lifesaver :D

posts.author: anon
posts.ceb: Abi nakog ma-underload na ko kay closed akong section, pero gi-magic sa Window 3 akong timetable. Salamat kaayo!
posts.en: Thought I'd be underloaded because my section closed, but Window 3 worked magic on my timetable. Thank you so much!

posts.author: anon
posts.ceb: Open Market karon murag Hunger Games! Samtang nagpili og section, kalit lang mahurot ang slots sa imong atubangan!
posts.en: Open Market today is like the Hunger Games! While picking a section, the slots literally vanish right in front of you!

posts.author: anon
posts.ceb: 1st year hangtod 4th year nag-abot sa Registrar para sa Open Market! Kaway-kaway sa mga nagbarog pa sa hallway hehe.
posts.en: 1st years to 4th years all collided at the Registrar for Open Market! Waving to everyone still standing in the hallway hehe.

posts.author: anon
posts.ceb: Extension day na pero pilion ra diay nga department ang pwede! Sayang akong plete paingon campus, basa-basa lagi og memo :(
posts.en: It's extension day but only listed departments are allowed! Wasted my fare to campus, should've read the memo :(

posts.author: anon
posts.ceb: Daghana namong nag-try og hangyo sa Window 3 bisan wala among department sa extension list uy. Walay nadala sa pahiyom hehe.
posts.en: So many of us tried pleading at Window 3 even though our department wasn't on the extension list. Smiles didn't work hehe.

posts.author: jericho_112
posts.ceb: Sulit akong pag-atang sukad kadlawon! Naa na koy slot ug nabalhin pa gyud sa way conflict. Banana cue para sa Window 3! :D
posts.en: Camping out since dawn paid off! Got my slot and moved into a conflict-free schedule. Banana cue for Window 3! :D

posts.author: jericho_112
posts.ceb: Salamat sa SA sa Window 3 nga wala gyud gipul-an sa akong nawong kada balik nako! Kompleto na gyud akong units.
posts.en: Thanks to the Window 3 SA who never got tired of seeing my face every time I came back! My units are finally complete.

posts.author: jericho_112
posts.ceb: Nagmata kog alas kwatro sa kadlawon para lang masaypan akong papel sa Window 3... sakit pa sa bulag uy :(
posts.en: I woke up at 4 AM just for my papers to get messed up at Window 3... hurts worse than a breakup :(

posts.author: jericho_112
posts.ceb: Kaila na man unta ta sa Window 3 pero nganong naglibog gihapon akong enrollment?! Hapit na lang ko mahimong suki sa pila.
posts.en: We already know each other at Window 3, how is my enrollment still a mess?! I'm practically a permanent resident of this line.

posts.author: carlo_104
posts.ceb: Bisan nahulog akong ID sa 13C nga jeep, na-search ra dayon akong record sa Window 3! Nakaginhawa ra gyud ko :D
posts.en: Even after my ID fell out on the 13C jeepney, Window 3 pulled up my record by number right away! Huge relief :D

posts.author: carlo_104
posts.ceb: Dala na nako akong ID karon, ug na-okay na pud ang pirma ni Engr.! Salamat kaayo sa Window 3.
posts.en: I actually brought my ID today, and Engr.'s signature got sorted out too! Huge thanks to Window 3.

posts.author: carlo_104
posts.ceb: Nawala na gani akong ID sa 13C, nasayop pa gyud ang pag-handle sa akong form sa Window 3. Dimalasa adlawa uy :(
posts.en: First I lose my ID on the 13C, then my form gets mishandled at Window 3. What an unlucky day :(

posts.author: carlo_104
posts.ceb: Nagtabang ra gani ko sa akong manghod nga 1st year, kami na nuon duha ang nagbalik-balik sa linya sa Window 3!
posts.en: I was just helping my 1st-year sibling, and now both of us are stuck going back and forth in the Window 3 line!

posts.author: mae_118
posts.ceb: Worth it akong color-coded ug alphabetized nga slips! Paspas kaayo ko nahuman sa Window 3, abot pa ko sa OAS interview :D
posts.en: My color-coded and alphabetized slips paid off! Finished super fast at Window 3 and made my OAS interview on time :D

posts.author: mae_118
posts.ceb: Kompleto na akong maintaining load para sa scholarship! Salamat sa Window 3 sa pag-atiman sa akong Accounting subjects.
posts.en: My scholarship maintaining load is complete! Thank you Window 3 for taking care of my Accounting subjects.

posts.author: mae_118
posts.ceb: Gi-color-code ug gi-plastic envelope na nako tanan, pero nasayop gihapon ang Window 3! Ma-late na ko sa OAS interview :(
posts.en: I color-coded and put everything in a plastic envelope, and Window 3 still got it wrong! I'm gonna be late for my OAS interview :(

posts.author: mae_118
posts.ceb: Nagubot akong gi-alphabetize nga slips sa sige nakog balik sa Window 3! Kulbaan na kaayo ko sa akong scholarship load.
posts.en: My alphabetized slips are all out of order from coming back to Window 3! I'm so anxious about my scholarship load now.

posts.author: anon
posts.ceb: Gi-turn away ko sa Window 3, pero gi-explain gyud unsay problema ug unsay buhaton. Sakit, pero klaro hehe.
posts.en: Got turned away at Window 3, but they explained exactly what was wrong and what to do. Hurts, but it's clear hehe.

posts.author: jericho_112
posts.ceb: Wala diay sa extension list akong department, gi-turn away ko. Sakit, pero patas ang Window 3. Last na gyud, promise!
posts.en: My department wasn't on the extension list, so I got turned away. Hurts, but Window 3 was fair about it. Last one, promise!

posts.author: carlo_104
posts.ceb: Na-enroll na akong manghod nga freshman! Salamat sa Window 3, mas organized pa mo kaysa nako hehe.
posts.en: My freshman sibling is enrolled! Thanks Window 3, you're way more organized than me hehe.

posts.author: carlo_104
posts.ceb: Dala na gani nako akong ID karon, ang pirma ni Engr. na pud ang nagkaproblema sa Window 3. Dili gyud ko swertehon uy :(
posts.en: I finally brought my ID today, and now Engr.'s signature is the problem at Window 3. Luck just isn't on my side :(

posts.author: mae_118
posts.ceb: Gi-double check na nako akong prereqs, gi-double check pud sa Window 3. Teamwork! Na-survive nako ang Open Market :D
posts.en: I double-checked my prereqs, and Window 3 double-checked them too. Teamwork! I survived Open Market :D
